body: The battery with a field radio carry mustard-colored dust from the fertilizer trial. They were packed before traffic was turned around.
title: Battery with a field radio at Saturday before sunrise
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the mustard-colored dust while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

title: A route after midnight
body: The driver had been told the south road was open to families. Someone moved the barrier while we stopped for water. He went back to ask and was offered a different map with the old road drawn out of it.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
